brief.prompt: A single lateral cephalometric X-ray film showing a human skull in side profile, clipped to a softly glowing lightbox in a quiet orthodontic clinic. The jaw and skull base are clearly visible in grayscale, with no writing, markings or lines on the film.
brief.alt: Side-profile skull X-ray on a lightbox, the image used to measure the mandibular plane angle
brief.purpose: Shows the lateral cephalogram, the specific X-ray on which the mandibular plane angle is measured.

review.alt: Lateral cephalometric X-ray of a skull in side profile, showing the jaw, teeth, skull base and cervical spine, clipped to a lightbox in a dental clinic with a dental chair visible at the side.
